headline: Atul Choksy files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure for Apcotex Industries
sum: Atul Choksy has disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares in Apcotex Industries Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4). The disclosure signals a crossing of the 25% or greater shareholding threshold requiring mandatory takeover rules compliance.
detail: Atul Choksy submitted a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the NSE on or around 17 June 2026, reported publicly 22 June 2026. This regulation requires disclosure when a party acquires 25% or more of a company's voting share capital in a single transaction or series of transactions. The disclosure is the mandatory first step under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, commencing the statutory 60-day open-offer window. Exact shareholding acquired, consideration, and prior shareholding status are not yet publicly detailed in summary form.
